author: steps
subject: Reminder to complete your validation form

messages.text:
Dear Inés Calvo,

Welcome to the Brightwall app assessment programme! Your account has been successfully created and we are eager to help you strengthen your security posture.

It appears that your Validation Letter form is still incomplete and has not been submitted. Kindly complete the form as soon as possible so you can proceed with your assessment.

Once completed, you will gain access to your scan by following these steps:

1. Schedule a scan
   - Log in to the portal (https://portal.brightwall.example).
   - Navigate to "Project" and select "Submit assessment".
   - For web applications: choose Dynamic scan, provide the URL and start the scan.
   - For other applications: choose Static scan, upload your source code and submit.
2. Review and patch vulnerabilities
   - After the scan: open your report to review vulnerabilities and failed checks.
   - False positives: raise a ticket on the platform or write to help@brightwall.example.
3. Verify patches with a follow-up scan
   - After remediation, request a revalidation scan in the "Scans" section.
4. Complete the self-assessment questionnaire on the platform accurately.
5. Finalize your assessment
   - Once vulnerabilities are patched and the questionnaire is complete, contact help@brightwall.example for the Validation Letter.

Project details
Project ID: 58113
Number of applications: 1

Need help? Our support team is here for you at any point.

Best regards,
Brightwall Assurance team

readerOwes: Complete and submit the Validation Letter form
settled: The account was created; project 58113 covers one application
mustNotClaim: List the scan, patching, revalidation, questionnaire and final contact as separate things the reader has to do now

messages.text:
Estimada Lucía Paredes:

Su cita para la solicitud de visado está confirmada para el jueves 14 de enero de 2027 a las 10:40, en la oficina de Calle Mayor 12.

El día de la cita debe traer: pasaporte original, una fotografía reciente y el comprobante de pago de la tasa.

Qué ocurre después de la cita:
1. Tomaremos sus datos biométricos en la misma visita.
2. Su solicitud pasará a revisión (entre 10 y 15 días hábiles).
3. Recibirá un correo cuando el pasaporte esté listo para recoger.
4. Para recogerlo, presente el resguardo que le entregaremos en la cita.

Si necesita cambiar la cita, hágalo en el portal hasta 48 horas antes.

Atentamente,
Sección consular

readerOwes: Bring the original passport, a recent photo and the fee receipt to the appointment on Thursday 14 January 2027 at 10:40
mustNotClaim: Turn biometrics, review, the pickup email or the pickup into separate to-dos
List passport, photo and receipt as three separate items

Hello Pavel,

Your network password expires on Saturday 20 March. Please change it before then to avoid being locked out.

How to change it:
1. Go to the account page (https://account.quillsoft.example).

4. If you use the mobile mail app, sign in again with the new password afterwards.

If you are locked out, call the service desk on extension 4400.

Quillsoft IT
